frontmatter.name: memory-to-llms-txt
frontmatter.description: Export a maintained agent memory store into a private llms docset, preserving entry types, provenance, recency tiers and checked drift instead of reclustering away its structure. TRIGGER: "make MEMORY.md queryable", "export the .remember pyramid", "compile the memory store into llms.txt", "/memory2llms". SKIP: unstructured scratch or meeting notes → notes-to-llms- txt; repository code/docs → crawl-repo-to-llms; organize notes without llms output → note- organizer; audit an existing llms family → llms-deep-optimizer.
whenToUse: turn my memory files into an llms.txt
compile the memory store into a docset
whenNotToUse: the input is unstructured scratch notes, not a maintained memory store (use notes-to-llms-txt)
the source is a repo's code/docs, not its memory files (use crawl-repo-to-llms)
an llms.txt family already exists and just needs auditing (use llms-deep-optimizer)
